# Shubham Datarkar (The Kalamwala)

> Copywriter, marketer, and builder. CMO at Book A Sloth, founder & CEO of Timewheel Internet, and the maker behind The Bogus Company. Nearly a decade across copywriting, SEO, content, and growth — including an IPL 2021 animation TVC for Disney+ Hotstar. Based in Nagpur, India.

Tagline: Build what you market. Market what you build.
